# Agent SDK Core

> Description: A lightweight, zero-dependency Python framework for building LLM Agents and Swarms.
> Documentation: https://agent-sdk-core.dev/

## Core Documentation
- Introduction: https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/
- Installation: https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/getting-started/installation
- Quickstart: https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/getting-started/quickstart
- Agents & Runners: https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/modules/agents
- Tools: https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/modules/tools

## Middleware System (Key Features)
- Overview: https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/modules/middlewares/
- RAG (Memory): https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/modules/middlewares/retrieval-augmented-generation-rag-middleware
- Safety (Human in the Loop): https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/modules/middlewares/ai-safety-and-human-control-middleware
- Logging: https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/modules/middlewares/agent-logging-and-context-injection-middleware

## Advanced Topics
- Swarms & Multi-Agent: https://agent-sdk-core.dev/docs/advanced/swarm

## Usage Examples

### 1. Basic Agent
```python
import os
from agent_sdk import Runner, Agent, OpenAIClient

client = OpenAIClient(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))

agent = Agent(
    name="Helper",
    instructions="You are a helpful assistant.",
    model="gpt-4o"
)

runner = Runner(client)
response = runner.run(agent, "Hello!")
print(response)
```

### 2. RAG (Memory)
```python
from agent_sdk.middleware import SimpleRAG

# Auto-manages chat history and context
rag = SimpleRAG(db_path="memory.db")
runner.use(rag)
```

### 3. Human Approval
```python
from agent_sdk.middleware import HumanInTheLoop

runner.use(HumanInTheLoop()) 
# Pauses execution for user approval before running tools
```
